callsUsed.title: Scott Management | Entrata | Demo
callsUsed.brief: The Entrata team presented their accounting and advanced budgeting platform, addressing specific concerns and questions from the client team regarding vendor payments, approval workflows, reporting, and sub-property management. The client team expressed interest in further exploring the platform's capabilities but also voiced concerns about the implementation timeline and resource allocation, ultimately deciding to postpone further discussions until after the busy holiday season. The Entrata team agreed to follow up with additional information and schedule a call with an accounting consultant to address the client's specific needs.

callsUsed.brief: Christian, Kurt, Gerry and Annie from Entrata discussed Merged's transition to Entrata's unified platform, focusing on streamlining purchase orders, invoices, utility management, and maintenance workflows through automation, AI, and integrated data. The conversation also touched on the importance of internal process review and training to maximize the platform's extensive capabilities.
